items.summary: ResponseParser.read again reads the status line, charges it against MAX_HEAD_BYTES, then parses it (pre-2917400 order), keeping the StatusLine value and its http10 flag. An over-bound malformed status line now fails with cause 'the status line and headers exceed 65536 bytes' again. Pinned by two new raw-socket tests in BackendResponseParserTest (SEC-PROXY-004 AC-2). Note: the probe's second case (65511 'Y' after the 100 head) is exactly at the bound, not past it (the interim status line is 23 charged bytes; the blank line is not charged), so it gives 'malformed status line' under either order; the regression test uses one byte more (65512 'Y' + CRLF = 65514 > 65513 left) so it is truly over the bound.

Private method statusLine(String) renamed to parseStatusLine(String); the raw line local is rawStatusLine and the parsed value stays statusLine of type StatusLine, so the method no longer shares the name. Behaviour-preserving; no public symbol changed.
